lines.text: There is no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus, because the law of the Spirit of life set them free.
God sent His own Son as an offering for sin, so the law's righteous standard would be fulfilled in us.
The mind of the flesh is hostile to God, but the mind of the Spirit is wisdom and peace.
If the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus lives in you, He will give life to your mortal bodies.
We cry "Abba! Father!" and are children and priests of God, if we suffer with Him.
